premise: Sandpiper finds two strange things on the shore: a bottle that pops its cork at him and a ball that rolls away when pecked, so he goes back to looking for small things.
inspiration: The curious-creature cumulative tale (and what's this?), ending with the little one choosing his own small world.
lesson: Big surprises are fun; small things are good too.

en-US.title: The Curious Sandpiper
en-US.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Sandpiper ran along the shore, looking for something new. {sandpiper:face happy} [curious] What's this? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} A green glass bottle, rolling in the foam. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} He ran over. Tap, tap went his beak. {bottle:live} {sfx:pop} POP! went the cork. {sandpiper:face surprised} {sandpiper:hop x2} [gasps] Sandpiper jumped right up in the air! [laughs] Then he spotted something else: {ball:enter} a big round thing, red and yellow and blue and white. {sandpiper:go to ball by run} He ran over. {sandpiper:pulse} Tap, tap. {ball:go to sand another} And away it rolled! {sandpiper:go to ball by run} Sandpiper chased it, run, run, run, {ball:live} until it spun to a stop. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live} He gave it one tiny peck. Nothing happened. {sandpiper:wobble} [playfully] Good, said Sandpiper. Something that stays still. {ball:pulse} And off he went to look for tiny things, where everything was much, much smaller.

es-ES.title: El correlimos curioso
es-ES.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Correlimos corría por la orilla, buscando algo nuevo. {sandpiper:face happy} [curious] ¿Y esto qué es? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} Una botella de cristal verde, rodando entre la espuma. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Fue corriendo. Toc, toc, hizo su pico. {bottle:live} {sfx:pop} ¡POP!, hizo el corcho. {sandpiper:face surprised} {sandpiper:hop x2} [gasps] ¡Correlimos dio un salto en el aire! [laughs] Luego vio otra cosa: {ball:enter} una cosa grande y redonda, roja, amarilla, azul y blanca. {sandpiper:go to ball by run} Fue corriendo. {sandpiper:pulse} Toc, toc. {ball:go to sand another} ¡Y se fue rodando! {sandpiper:go to ball by run} Correlimos corrió detrás, corre, corre, corre, {ball:live} hasta que dio unas vueltas y se paró. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live} Le dio un picotazo diminuto. No pasó nada. {sandpiper:wobble} [playfully] Bien, dijo Correlimos. Algo que se queda quieto. {ball:pulse} Y se fue a buscar cositas pequeñas, donde todo era mucho, mucho más pequeño.
